description_expanded: Endless Summer Dream - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach Favorite Features: - Gulf View - 4 Min Walk To Beach - 12,000 sq. ft. Community Pool - Beach Tram - Monthly Rates Available - 4 Bikes Included  More About Endless Summer Dream: Endless Summer Dream is a four-bedroom, three-bathroom, private home in the prestigious community of Seacrest Beach off of County Highway 30A. This three-story vacation home sleeps 12 in comfortable, luxurious accommodations. Bright outdoor furniture, plenty of deck and patio space, and community amenities promote time spent outdoors with family and friends. Additionally, this home was just completely remodeled with new furnishings for the 2019 season.   Looking for a freshwater option while staying on the Emerald Coast? Enjoy the community pool that is available to all guests of ‘Endless Summer Dream.’ At 12,000 square-feet, the lagoon pool evokes a feeling of excitement based off size alone! In addition, with community and beach tram service, heading to the beautiful beaches of South Walton has never been easier!   Guests will be greeted to the home by an open floor plan living area. The kitchen offers wood flooring throughout and stainless steel Whirlpool appliances. The formal dining seating is available for eight guests, while additional seating for two is available at barstools along the kitchen counter. The living room features seating for six, a flat-screen TV, a DVD player, and access to the first-floor porch that offers seating, a grill, and a porch swing. A King Suite with a king bed, flat-screen TV, walk-in closet, and private porch access is also located on the first floor. A full, en-suite bath with a shower/tub combo services the King Suite.   The second floor hosts two additional suites and the home’s laundry room. The second floor King Suite has a King bed, a flat-screen TV, a private balcony, a walk-in closet, and an en-suite bath with a shower/tub combo. The home’s luxurious Master Suite has a King bed, a flat-screen TV, a walk-in closet, and a private balcony. The Master Bath is complete with dual sinks, a jetted tub, and a stand-alone shower.   The third floor is dedicated to the home’s bunk room. Three sets of twin bunks sleep 6, while a flat-screen TV and a mini-fridge service the room. The bunk room also has its own balcony overlooking the community.   Endless Summer Dream is the perfect home for families looking to stay in a quiet community near the beaches of 30A! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 4: 3 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds with Shared Balcony.
